name: False Life
description: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration. These temporary hit points absorb damage before your real hit points, and vanish at the end of the duration.
effect: A cold shell of borrowed life: 1d4+4 temporary HP now in a fight, or 7 temporary HP at the start of every fight for the next 8 hours.
notes: In combat: 1d4+4 temporary HP, which soak damage before your HP.
Out of combat: for 8 hours you start every fight with 7 temporary HP.
